data.description:
## Problem

Surfaced while fixing `anatomical-arbored-oyster` (e3e0-2e7c-b280-4b4a). Once that fix removed the `FileNotFoundError` collection error (macOS leg) and the `license-files` build `TypeError` (floor leg), the `Test Suite (mirror)` legs run to completion and reveal a large, **pre-existing** failure class that was previously masked.

Dominant macOS-leg error (~90 failures across `test_provider_parity`, `test_transport_retry`, `test_llm_fallback_chain`, `test_llm_provider_factory`, `test_llm_timeouts`, `test_web_tool_gating`, `test_llm_config_gate_root`, ...):

```
Error: Invalid `http_client` argument; Expected an instance of `httpx2.AsyncClient` but got <class 'httpx.AsyncClient'>
```

## Root cause

`pyproject.toml` declares `pydantic-ai-slim[anthropic,retries,duckduckgo]>=1.107,<2` but places **no upper bound on the `anthropic` SDK itself**. The mirror sweep installs UNLOCKED:
- `sweep (macos, full suite)`: `uv pip install '.[dev,reviewbot,ui]'` (non-editable)
- `sweep (declared lower-bound resolution)`: `uv pip install --resolution lowest-direct '.[dev,agents]'`

Both resolve `anthropic==1.2.0`, whose client vendors `httpx2` and **rejects** a stdlib `httpx.AsyncClient`. rebar's provider seam (`src/rebar/llm/anthropic_model.py:_build_retrying_anthropic_provider` -> `anthropic/_client.py:__init__`) passes an `httpx.AsyncClient`, so construction raises `TypeError` and cascades into every Anthropic-touching test. The Verified merge gate is green because `uv.lock` pins an older, compatible anthropic; only the unlocked sweep legs float to 1.2.0.

## Fix direction (DESIGN — needs decision)

Either (a) add an `anthropic` upper-bound/pin compatible with the pydantic-ai `http_client` seam, or (b) stop passing a stdlib `httpx.AsyncClient` into the anthropic provider when the installed SDK expects its vendored client. This changes the dependency contract / provider construction, so it is a design decision, not a mechanical test fix.

## Evidence
- Mirror run 33299427686 (dispatched on `main` post-fix): `sweep (macos, full suite)` job 99224621948, `sweep (declared lower-bound resolution)` job 99224621821.
- `anthropic==1.2.0` shown installing in the macOS leg; error string above aggregated 90x.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The `Test Suite (mirror)` `sweep (macos, full suite)` and `sweep (declared lower-bound resolution)` legs no longer raise `Invalid http_client argument; Expected ... httpx2.AsyncClient`.
- [ ] A resolution that floats `anthropic` to its latest (or its declared floor) constructs the Anthropic provider without `TypeError`, on both editable and non-editable installs.
- [ ] The dependency constraint (or provider-seam change) is portable across CI providers / no CI.
data.title: Mirror sweep: unbounded anthropic SDK resolves to 1.2.0 (httpx2) and rejects httpx.AsyncClient on non-editable/floor legs
